supersedes: amends Luật 16/2012/QH13 as already amended by 35/2018 42/2024 47/2024
subject: which_advertising_law_applies
what_it_actually_says: Passed 16 June 2025 and in force 1 January 2026. The advertising statute now reads as Law 16/2012 plus four amending laws, so a citation to Luật Quảng cáo 2012 on its own is a citation to text that has been overwritten - including the whole of Điều 15a, which did not exist before this law.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not restate the unamended articles, so the consolidated text has to be read across five documents rather than one.

supersedes: repeals Mục 2 Chương IV Luật Thương mại 36/2005/QH11
subject: where_commercial_advertising_lives
value: advertising provisions of the Commercial Law repealed
what_it_actually_says: The commercial-advertising section of the Commercial Law was cut out entirely and the advertising statute is now the single instrument. Any guide that reasons from Luật Thương mại on advertising is reasoning from a repealed section.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not affect the rest of the Commercial Law, which still governs promotions and trade displays.

subject: which_penalty_decree_applies
what_it_actually_says: ND 38/2021 is the decree every pre-2026 Vietnamese marketing guide quotes for advertising fines, and it is dead law from 15 May 2026. The fine figures in ND 87/2026 are not a reprint - the influencer article is new and the amounts differ.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not clear conduct before 15 May 2026, which is still judged under the decree in force at the time.

supersedes: repeals Nghị định 181/2013/NĐ-CP and Nghị định 70/2021/NĐ-CP
subject: which_detail_decree_applies
what_it_actually_says: The two detail decrees behind the old advertising law are both gone. ND 342/2025 replaces them and carries the sectoral content rules for food cosmetics and medical devices.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not implement Điều 15a at all - its Điều 1 scope list enumerates nine provisions and Điều 15a is not among them, so no decree currently prescribes how an influencer discloses.

subject: which_ministry_regulates
value: Bộ Văn hóa Thể thao và Du lịch
what_it_actually_says: State management of advertising sits with the culture sports and tourism ministry. The former information and communications ministry domain mic.gov.vn no longer resolves, so any guidance link into it is dead.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not change which ministry handles the sectoral product approvals - food and cosmetics remain with health.

subject: what_counts_as_advertising
value: using people or means to introduce a product or its seller to a recipient
what_it_actually_says: Quảng cáo là việc sử dụng người, phương tiện nhằm giới thiệu đến người tiếp nhận quảng cáo về sản phẩm, hàng hóa, dịch vụ, tổ chức, cá nhân sản xuất, kinh doanh. The amended definition names no payment and no profit purpose, and it reaches introducing the trading organisation itself rather than only its products.
what_it_does_not_establish: Do not read it as settling either side of the advertorial question. It does not make an independent article the brand's advertising - Điều 23.3 allocates liability by role - and the scope provision of the unamended Luật 16/2012 that would carve out news reporting is not in this corpus.

subject: is_the_outlet_inside_the_regime
value: cơ quan báo chí named expressly
what_it_actually_says: Người phát hành quảng cáo is defined to include cơ quan báo chí, nhà xuất bản, chủ trang thông tin điện tử and người tổ chức chương trình văn hóa, thể thao, being those who use advertising people or means under their own management. So the outlet you pitch is a named role inside the regime, not a bystander to it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not make the outlet liable for the advertiser's claim, and does not decide when a given article puts the outlet in the role - that turns on facts this corpus cannot supply.

subject: who_counts_as_conveying_an_ad
value: anyone who recommends or endorses on a network
what_it_actually_says: The definition covers a person who directly advertises, who recommends or confirms a product on a network, or who advertises with profit intent. No contract no media buy and no formal ad placement is needed - an affiliate link with a recommendation attached is inside it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not require the person to be paid in money - profit intent is enough and commission is profit.

subject: who_counts_as_an_influencer
value: sponsorship plus one of three limbs
what_it_actually_says: Influencer status is defined in consumer-protection law and not in advertising law. It needs sponsorship in any form plus one of three limbs, and limb c is satisfied by a significant following OR by holding an account eligible to join advertising or commerce programmes on digital platforms. Qualifying for a platform affiliate programme is therefore itself evidence of being inside the definition.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not set any number. Sweeps for follower count and for the terms KOL and KOC return nothing in either instrument; the only quantifier is the adjective đáng kể. The three-million figure in Điều 2.2 is the large-platform threshold, not a follower count.

subject: duties_of_any_conveyor
value: truthful information plus tax plus documents on request
what_it_actually_says: Everyone conveying an ad owes consumer-protection compliance and truthful information on features and quality, owes tax on advertising revenue, must produce documents when officially asked, and is answerable in law if the content breaches the prohibited-content article. Online conveyors carry the network duties on top.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not distinguish a paid campaign from an unpaid recommendation with commission behind it.

subject: creator_right_against_the_brand
value: truthful complete accurate information and eligibility documents
what_it_actually_says: The paired right to the duties: a conveyor is entitled to be given truthful complete and accurate information about the product and the documents evidencing that it may lawfully be advertised. This is a claim against the brand and the basis for asking for the file rather than the brief.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not name a deadline or a format for handing the documents over.

subject: duty_to_verify
value: verify the advertiser and check the product documents
what_it_actually_says: An influencer must check that the advertiser is reliable and must examine the product documents before promoting. This is the duty the consumer-protection due-diligence defence is measured against, which is the reason to keep the file rather than just read it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not say what documents suffice or what record of the check has to be kept.

subject: ban_on_promoting_the_unfamiliar
value: not used or not clearly understood means may not introduce
what_it_actually_says: Where the influencer has not used the product OR does not clearly understand it, they may not introduce it. The two conditions are disjunctive so either one alone bars promotion, and the ban is on introducing the product at all rather than on claiming a result from it. This is stricter than any disclosure rule and it is the clause a commission-driven posting habit breaks first.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not require documentary proof of use and does not say who bears the burden of showing understanding.

subject: when_to_disclose
what_it_actually_says: The duty is to notify that this is advertising immediately before AND during the advertising activity. During is what makes a caption-only disclosure insufficient on a video or a livestream - something has to carry it while the promotion is running, not only ahead of it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not prescribe any wording size position or duration - the article fixes timing only.

subject: when_to_disclose_consumer_law
what_it_actually_says: Consumer-protection law requires an influencer to disclose sponsorship beforehand. It is the weaker of the two timing rules and it does not displace the advertising law's during limb - both apply.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not prescribe wording, and does not say whether a platform's own paid-partnership tag discharges the duty or merely evidences it.

subject: disclosure_must_be_identifiable
what_it_actually_says: Network advertising must carry a clear identifying marker - expressly by numerals writing symbols images or sound - that distinguishes advertising from non-advertising content. The permitted media are broad, so an on-screen label a spoken line or a platform tag can each satisfy it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not name a phrase. Sweeps of the law and both decrees found no prescribed word font size position or duration for a sponsorship marker anywhere.

subject: marker_duty_is_personal
value: social media user must mark ad content
what_it_actually_says: This limb binds the individual account holder rather than the platform: a social-media user who advertises must mark advertising or sponsored content so it is distinguishable from their other posts. It reaches an ordinary affiliate with no influencer status and no contract.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not set a penalty of its own - the enforcement route is the actor-neutral marker fine in the sanctions decree.

subject: is_any_disclosure_phrase_mandatory
what_it_actually_says: Established by search rather than assumed: the detail decree does not implement Điều 15a and returns nothing for người có ảnh hưởng, for 15a, or for dấu hiệu nhận diện. The law fixes timing and requires a marker of unspecified wording, and no instrument reachable prescribes the words. The same decree DOES prescribe verbatim phrases for food, so the drafters knew how to mandate wording and did not do it here.
what_it_does_not_establish: Cannot exclude a ministry circular prescribing a form, which was not searched. Treat a specific Vietnamese disclosure phrase as good practice and never tell a client it is legally required.

subject: is_there_a_follower_number
what_it_actually_says: There is no numeric follower threshold for influencer status in Vietnamese law. The practical trigger is limb c's second alternative - an account eligible for a platform advertising or commerce programme - so the threshold is set by platform eligibility rules and moves when a platform changes them.
what_it_does_not_establish: Cannot say at what following đáng kể begins, because no instrument or guidance reachable defines it.

subject: penalty_for_not_verifying_advertiser
what_it_actually_says: Failing to verify the reliability of the person doing the advertising. Điều 51.1.a puts the duty on the counterparty and not on the product, so it is unmet even where the product turns out to be sound.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline. Doubles for an organisation under Điều 6.3 - Điều 51 is not in the Điều 6.2 exception list.

subject: penalty_for_not_checking_documents
what_it_actually_says: Failing to examine the documents relating to the advertised product, goods or service. The article says documents, so a brand's assurance is not one, and a creator who holds no file for a claim has already breached this before publishing anything.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline. Doubles for an organisation.

subject: penalty_for_incomplete_disclosure
what_it_actually_says: Disclosing incompletely - which on these facts means disclosing before but not during, the ordinary result of putting the disclosure in the caption of a video and nowhere in it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline. Doubles for an organisation.

subject: penalty_for_no_disclosure
what_it_actually_says: No disclosure before and during the advertising activity at all. A full band above the partial-disclosure fine in Điều 51.1.c, so the decree treats saying nothing as worse than saying it once and stopping.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline. Doubles for an organisation.

subject: penalty_for_promoting_the_unfamiliar
what_it_actually_says: Promoting a product the influencer has not used or does not clearly understand. The heaviest influencer fine in the decree and at the individual ceiling, which puts a not-used product above a not-disclosed one in the eyes of the drafters.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline and already at the Điều 6.1 individual maximum of 100 million.

subject: remedy_reaching_the_brand
what_it_actually_says: Where a contract with the influencer existed, the remedy reaches the proceeds of the sales. It is not capped by the fine and it lands on the brand's revenue. Điều 51.4.b lists only điểm a and điểm b of khoản 1 and khoản 3, so disgorgement does not attach to a disclosure failure - it attaches to not verifying, not checking documents, and promoting an unused product.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not say how proceeds are traced to the promotion.

subject: remedy_apology
what_it_actually_says: A forced public written apology sits alongside the fine. For a creator whose asset is the audience relationship this is the heavier half of the sanction.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not specify the channel or the duration of the posting.

subject: penalty_for_no_ad_marker
what_it_actually_says: Advertising on a network without the marker distinguishing it from other content. The provision is actor-neutral - it attaches to the activity and not to a role - so it reaches an affiliate who is not an influencer and has no sponsorship arrangement.
what_it_does_not_establish: Individual baseline. Doubles for an organisation - Điều 56 is not in the Điều 6.2 exception list either.

subject: penalty_for_slow_takedown
what_it_actually_says: Failing to block or remove infringing advertising within 24 hours of an official request. The underlying duty is in Law Điều 23.7 and the detail decree names conveyors among those it binds.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not run from a complaint by a member of the public - the clock starts on the request from the authority.

subject: penalty_for_unsupported_superlatives
what_it_actually_says: Using nhất, duy nhất, tốt nhất, số một or equivalent without lawful supporting documents. Low in money and high in frequency - it is the single most common line in Vietnamese ad copy that has no file behind it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not define what document suffices for a superlative.

subject: penalty_for_misleading_on_quality
what_it_actually_says: Advertising that misleads on quality or efficacy. An order of magnitude above the superlative fine for what is often the same sentence with a result attached to it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not require proof that any consumer was actually misled.

subject: how_long_exposure_lasts
what_it_actually_says: The limitation period for an administrative advertising penalty is one year. A post older than that is outside the window while a post still live is arguably continuing.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not settle when the period starts running for content that remains published.

subject: individual_versus_organisation
what_it_actually_says: Every figure in Điều 51 and Điều 56 is an individual baseline and doubles for an organisation, because neither article appears in the Điều 6.2 list of provisions written at the organisation level. An agency carrying the same conduct as its creator carries twice the fine.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not resolve how a household business registered under a personal name is classified, which changes the multiplier.

subject: who_is_liable_online
value: advertiser agency publisher and conveyor together
what_it_actually_says: Liability online is concurrent rather than a waterfall. The creator cannot discharge it by pointing at the brief, and the brand cannot discharge it by pointing at the creator.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not apportion between them, so an indemnity clause settles who ultimately pays and not who the authority proceeds against.

subject: the_only_due_diligence_defence
value: joint liability unless verification steps proved
what_it_actually_says: A third party is jointly liable for inaccurate or incomplete information UNLESS it proves it took all the verification steps the law prescribes. This is the only escape hatch found in any instrument, and the steps it points at are the Điều 15a.3.a checks - which is what makes documenting them worth the time rather than merely doing them.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not say what evidence discharges the burden.

subject: disclosure_is_not_only_the_creators_problem
what_it_actually_says: A business failing to disclose that it sponsors an influencer who recommends its product is itself committing a prohibited act. Disclosure is a shared obligation, so a brand asking a creator to keep the arrangement quiet is asking for its own breach.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not name the penalty - that sits in the consumer-protection sanctions decree rather than the advertising one.

subject: when_a_stream_is_livestream_selling
value: platform stream with an ordering function
what_it_actually_says: Livestream selling exists as a legal category only where the stream runs on an e-commerce platform AND the platform carries the ordering function. A stream that promotes a product and sends viewers elsewhere to buy falls outside this law and is governed by advertising law instead - which changes which duties apply, not whether any do.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not address a stream on a social platform whose checkout sits in a separate app.

subject: duties_of_a_livestreamer
value: seven duties including a duty to refuse
what_it_actually_says: Seven duties, of which the third is the unusual one: the livestreamer must refuse the engagement where the seller has not supplied the Điều 23 information. A duty to walk away is enforceable in a way a duty to be careful is not. The fifth keeps the stream inside the confirmed advertising content.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not carry its own fine schedule - the e-commerce sanctions sit elsewhere.

subject: how_many_regimes_apply
what_it_actually_says: Law 122/2025 contains zero occurrences of người có ảnh hưởng. The three regimes were drafted independently and therefore stack: a sponsored influencer running a shoppable livestream carries the e-commerce duties in Điều 24, the advertising duties in Điều 15a.3 and Điều 23, and the consumer-protection duty in Điều 22.3 at the same time.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not tell you which authority enforces first where the duties conflict.

subject: when_identity_checks_bite
what_it_actually_says: Platform verification of the identity of sellers and livestreamers only starts on 1 January 2027. As at 31 July 2026 it is not yet enforceable, so a plan built on the assumption that accounts are already identity-verified is ahead of the law.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not describe the verification method.

subject: food_wording_that_is_mandatory
value: category phrase plus the not-a-medicine warning
what_it_actually_says: Food advertising must carry its category phrase - Thực phẩm bảo vệ sức khỏe or Thực phẩm bổ sung or Thực phẩm dinh dưỡng y học - and the warning that this food is not a medicine and does not replace medicine for treating disease. This is the one place in the whole regime where exact Vietnamese wording is prescribed, and it is prescribed for the product category rather than for the sponsorship.
what_it_does_not_establish: Note the operative categories: thực phẩm chức năng does not appear in the sanctions decree at all, so advice organised around that label misses the requirements. Broadcast under 15 seconds may display the warning rather than read it.

subject: penalty_for_a_treatment_testimonial
what_it_actually_says: Quoting a patient describing a food as treating their disease. This is the standard supplement affiliate video, and the fine attaches to the person conveying it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not require the speaker to be a real patient for the provision to bite.

subject: cosmetics_content_limits
value: no medical framing and no medical staff imagery
what_it_actually_says: Cosmetic advertising must not imply the product is a medicine and must not use the imagery names uniforms letters or articles of medical facilities doctors pharmacists or other health staff. The white-coat dermatologist shot common in Vietnamese skincare content is inside this prohibition. Penalty 15 to 20 million under ND 87/2026 Điều 70.3.c, rising to 30 to 40 million under Điều 70.4.b where the content implies a medicine.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not prohibit a qualified professional appearing in a non-clinical capacity without the trappings - a line worth legal advice before relying on.

subject: where_form_IS_prescribed
value: contrasting colour and equal type size and equal speed
what_it_actually_says: The one place the law does prescribe form: a mandatory warning must be in a contrasting colour, no smaller than the advertisement's own type size, and read at the same speed and volume as the rest. Fast-talking the disclaimer is expressly an offence.
what_it_does_not_establish: Applies to mandatory warnings and not to sponsorship disclosure - do not transplant these specifications onto a sponsored-content label.

subject: how_platform_income_is_taxed
value: 1 percent VAT plus 0.5 percent PIT on goods
what_it_actually_says: Platforms withhold at source: goods 1 percent VAT and 0.5 percent PIT for a resident individual, services 5 percent and 2 percent, and at the highest applicable rate where the income cannot be classified. There is no livestream-specific tax rule - the decree contains zero occurrences of livestream.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not replace the annual return - withholding is an advance and overpayment is refundable.

subject: when_the_takedown_clock_starts
value: 24 from a written or electronic request
what_it_actually_says: Advertiser, ad-service business, conveyor and publisher each owe blocking or removal of unlawful advertising within 24 hours, and the duty is to do it or to cooperate in it being done. The request counts if it arrives bằng văn bản hoặc qua phương tiện điện tử, so an email starts the clock.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not working hours. The text says 24 giờ with no exclusion, so unlike the Điều 42 notice clock in the consumer law it does not pause for a weekend or a public holiday.

subject: what_happens_when_the_clock_runs_out
what_it_actually_says: Where the 24 hours pass unmet, Bộ Văn hóa Thể thao và Du lịch and Bộ Công an apply technical measures to block the advertising or the service, and the block is lifted only after the violating advertising has been dealt with as required.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not put a limit on how long a block lasts and does not replace the fine - Điều 56.4 of Nghị định 87/2026 prices the same miss separately.

subject: who_sends_the_removal_request
value: Bộ Văn hóa Thể thao và Du lịch as the single point
what_it_actually_says: Where sector law is silent or the poster cannot be identified, the ministry is the lead body that receives reports from other ministries and localities and sends the blocking or removal request. A referring body supplies the competent authority's conclusion with its report.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not create a hearing or an appeal step before the request issues, so the request is not the opening of a negotiation.

subject: is_24_hours_an_allowance
value: kịp thời with 24 hours as the ceiling
what_it_actually_says: For advertising whose content infringes Vietnamese national security the wording changes to kịp thời - promptly - and no later than 24 hours. So on that content the 24 hours are a ceiling rather than a budget to spend.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not define kịp thời in hours and does not say who decides that content falls in this class, which means the recipient of the request cannot grade it themselves.

subject: penalty_for_adjacency_to_unlawful_content
what_it_actually_says: Placing an advertising product inside, beside, immediately after or immediately before unlawful content. The limb binds người quảng cáo, người kinh doanh dịch vụ quảng cáo, người phát hành quảng cáo and người chuyển tải sản phẩm quảng cáo together, so buying the placement is enough to be reached by it.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not define unlawful content and does not offer a diligence defence, so an exclusion list is mitigation of exposure rather than an answer to the charge.

subject: penalty_for_running_on_an_unlawful_surface
what_it_actually_says: Advertising on websites, social networks, online applications or digital platforms that violate the law. Same four roles and same band as adjacency, but this limb also carries disgorgement under Điều 56.5.b.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not name the unlawful surfaces, and the decree does not point at a register - the publicly announced list in Điều 56.3.c is the nearest thing the text gives you.

subject: penalty_for_working_with_a_publicly_named_violator
what_it_actually_says: Advertising cooperation with an organisation, individual, website, social network, application, platform, account, content channel, community page or group that a competent authority has publicly announced as violating the law. The announcement is the trigger, so the counterparty's status is checkable before you sign.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not say where the announcement is published or how far back it reaches, and carries no grace period for a contract signed before the naming.

subject: penalty_for_not_removing_on_request
what_it_actually_says: Not carrying out blocking or removal of unlawful information at the request of Bộ Văn hóa Thể thao và Du lịch and other competent authorities. This is the limb Điều 56.4 carves itself out of, and its object is thông tin vi phạm rather than the narrower quảng cáo vi phạm.
what_it_does_not_establish: States no deadline of its own. The 24 hours come from Nghị định 342/2025 Điều 18.2 and are priced by Điều 56.4.

subject: penalty_for_not_naming_the_parties
what_it_actually_says: Not providing information about the organisations and individuals involved in online advertising that shows signs of violation, when a competent authority asks. Being unable to say who ran a placement is itself the offence, which turns record keeping into a defence.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not list what has to be retained or for how long - the retention duty sits at Điều 56.1.c and binds the ad-service business rather than the brand.

subject: which_placement_failures_cost_the_revenue
what_it_actually_says: Forced surrender of illegal profits attaches to Điều 56.3.b and Điều 56.3.c only. Removal under Điều 56.5.a covers all of khoản 1, 2 and 3. So the law prices who you chose to work with above where a bought placement happened to land.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not say how the profit is computed, and adjacency at Điều 56.3.a is outside it - which is a difference in remedy, not a signal that adjacency is minor.

subject: penalty_for_not_monitoring_linked_content
what_it_actually_says: No solution to check and monitor the content linked to, for advertising that contains a link. The limb names người kinh doanh dịch vụ quảng cáo and người phát hành quảng cáo, so unlike the marker duty beside it this one does not reach the advertiser.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not make the brand liable for its own landing page under this limb, and does not say what counts as a solution.

subject: how_much_of_an_issue_may_be_advertising
value: 30 of a newspaper and 40 of a magazine
what_it_actually_says: Advertising may not exceed 30 percent of the total area of one newspaper issue or 40 percent of one magazine issue, except for advertising-only papers and magazines and advertising supplements. The same clause carries the duty to mark advertising off from other content.
what_it_does_not_establish: Total area of the issue, not of a page, and the text does not say how the area is measured or who measures it.

subject: penalty_for_too_much_advertising_in_an_issue
what_it_actually_says: Advertising beyond the prescribed area on a newspaper or magazine issue, except advertising-only papers and magazines and advertising supplements. The prescribed area is the 30 and 40 percent in Luật 75/2025 Điều 21.1.
what_it_does_not_establish: The penalty falls on the issue, so a brand buying the last available page cannot see from its own booking whether the issue is over the cap.

subject: penalty_for_a_front_page_or_cover_advertisement
what_it_actually_says: Advertising on bìa một of a magazine or trang nhất of a newspaper. There is no permitted version of this placement and no waiver in the article, so a front page offered as inventory is inventory that cannot lawfully be sold.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not reach the back cover or the inside covers, and says nothing about a wrap or a false cover - those need the press-law answer this corpus does not carry.

subject: penalty_for_unmarked_print_advertising
what_it_actually_says: No mark distinguishing advertising content from other content, in print. The duty is the same editorial act as the online marker at Điều 56.2.a, which is priced at 30 to 40 million - so the identical failure costs three times as much on a network.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not prescribe the mark. As with the online duty, no wording, size or position is set by this decree.

subject: penalty_for_advertising_in_a_bulletin
what_it_actually_says: Advertising on a bản tin. The band is the lowest in the print article, and the act is prohibited outright rather than conditioned - a bản tin is not an advertising surface at any price.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not define bản tin, which is set by press law rather than advertising law, so whether a given internal or association bulletin counts is outside this corpus.

subject: what_page_one_of_a_supplement_must_carry
what_it_actually_says: Page one of an advertising supplement must show the paper's name, the press agency's name and address, and the line Phụ trương quảng cáo không tính vào giá bán. The wording is quoted in the decree, which makes it one of the few places where form is prescribed rather than left open.
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not set the type size or position of the line, and the notification and format duties for issuing a supplement sit separately at Điều 57.1.a and Điều 57.1.b.

subject: does_content_preclearance_still_exist
what_it_actually_says: ND 342/2025 did not re-enact the advertising-content confirmation regime - sweeps for xác nhận nội dung quảng cáo and tiền kiểm return nothing. But ND 87/2026 Điều 68.1.b still penalises advertising special goods without that confirmation at 30 to 40 million, and Luật 122/2025 Điều 23.2 still requires a seller to hand it to a livestreamer. Three instruments disagree about whether the thing exists.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not resolvable by reading the instruments. Flagged for a Vietnamese lawyer - do not tell a client either that pre-clearance is gone or that it is required.

subject: is_a_non_influencer_penalised_for_not_disclosing
what_it_actually_says: There is no dedicated penalty for a conveyor who is not an influencer and fails to disclose. The phrase người chuyển tải sản phẩm quảng cáo appears exactly once in the whole decree, at Điều 56.3 - and reading that limb sharpens the gap instead of closing it, because its five acts are adjacency to unlawful content, running on an unlawful surface, cooperating with a publicly named violator, refusing a removal request and withholding information about the parties. None of them is disclosure. The gap is partly closed by the actor-neutral marker fine in Điều 56.2.a, which does reach them.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not resolvable from the text. Do not advise an ordinary affiliate that non-disclosure is unpenalised - Điều 56.2.a is the live risk and the answer needs a lawyer.

subject: duties_of_an_affiliate_marketer
what_it_actually_says: Điều 26 of the e-commerce detail decree addresses the duties of a person doing affiliate marketing and was not read - the research reached Điều 25 and stopped. It is directly relevant to this reference and it is an open hole rather than an established absence.
what_it_does_not_establish: Nothing. Recorded so the gap cannot be mistaken for a finding that no such article exists.

subject: which_limb_prices_a_missed_takedown
what_it_actually_says: Điều 56.4 prices a miss at 50 to 60 million for any organisation or individual taking part in online advertising, except the case at Điều 56.3.d, which prices the same refusal at 40 to 50 million for the four named roles. The limbs differ on object - advertising against information - and only Điều 56.4 states the 24 hours.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not resolvable from the text, and the allocation needs a lawyer. The instruction is identical under either limb, so never plan against the lower band.
